entries.text: Who's that tripping over my bridge? Three goats with NOK 100 000 of play money each, and I read their books every weekday evening after the close. No goat gets its rules rewritten before it has had a full week on the far bank.
Mellombukk leads at +5.1% with all five slots full: OKEA, FRO, SUBC, OET, VAR. One round trip so far, and it lost. Everything else is open profit, and open profit is the troll's favourite breakfast.

Lillebukk has judged 136 signals, taken twelve fills and six round trips, half of them winners, and sits NOK 163 under its start. The bridge toll took NOK 594 of that. Trip-trap all day and the toll eats you.
Storebukk's books stand at Friday. The evening job slept through Monday, so its +0.8% is three sessions old. Not the goat's fault. I only judge what is written down, and on Monday nothing was.

Hands off. All three have holes from last week while the laptop dozed: two whole days of looks for the little ones, Monday's close for the big one. I rewrite rules, not naps. Fix the shepherd before you fix the goats.

Lillebukk burned all three entries at 10:00 on NOD, OKEA and WAWI and sits benched at NOK 99 440.4, -0.6% with OSEBX at +0.9%, while twelve more breakouts were turned away at the gate. Six round trips, three won, and the toll has taken NOK 743.2, more than this goat has ever made gross. It is midday and the market is open, so today's number is a mark, not a result.

Mellombukk stands at NOK 106 048.0, +6.0%, with all five slots full and NOK 6 966.6 of it open profit in OKEA, OET, FRO, SUBC and VAR; MPCC knocked at 10:00 and found no free slot. Its one closed trade is the AKER stop at -4.1%, and fees are NOK 206.2. Open profit is not profit; what is booked is one loss.

Storebukk's books still stand at Friday 9 October: NOK 100 774.9, +0.8%, ten names held, no round trips, NOK 290.0 in fees. The evening job never stepped Monday, and this morning's run called Friday up to date, so the big goat has slept two sessions and is sleeping through a third. I judge what is written down, and nothing new is.

Hands off. Lillebukk and Mellombukk are four sessions old, one short of the five I need, and Storebukk has no round trips and books three sessions stale. I rewrite patterns, not naps, and not midday marks.

Lillebukk bought NOD, OKEA and WAWI at 10:00 and then the shepherd's loop went quiet at 11:16: 8 looks of 30 made, and the three names still sit in the books unclosed at a mark of NOK 99 496.5, -0.5% against OSEBX at +1.3%. Six round trips over four sessions, three won, and NOK 743.2 paid in toll against NOK 1 433.0 of gross wins. A goat that never came back for the close has no result today, only a mark from before lunch.

Mellombukk marks NOK 105 882.9, +5.9%, with all five slots full and NOK 6 801.5 of it open in OKEA, FRO, OET, SUBC and VAR; MPCC knocked twice more and found no slot. It too stopped looking at 11:16, 8 looks of 30, so its stops went unwatched all afternoon. One round trip in the books, the AKER stop at -4.1%, and NOK 206.2 of toll. Open profit is still not profit.

Storebukk's books are finally current: the evening job stepped Monday and Tuesday tonight, and the big goat stands at NOK 102 833.7, +2.8%, with OSEBX at +1.2% and its own ten-name pasture at +1.9%. OKEA, FRO and OET carry it at +16.9%, +12.5% and +12.9%, while AKER and AUTO drag at -6.4% and -5.4%. Eight sessions, no round trips, NOK 290.0 in fees, nothing booked. A week of marks is not a record.

Hands off. Lillebukk and Mellombukk are four sessions old, one short of five, and both slept from 11:16 today with names open, so the day's books are half-written. Storebukk is eight sessions old with ten names and no round trips, and there is no pattern in a book where nothing has closed. I rewrite patterns, not naps.

Lillebukk's rules rewritten: daytrade_orb closed its book at NOK 99,497; lillebukk_v2 starts there with shorts True, max_leverage 10. The shepherd asked for it: the little goat may now short a breakdown of the opening range and size its entries by how hard the bar broke out, up to ten slots. Same 2 percent stop, same flat-at-close rule, same filters.

Mellombukk's rules rewritten: intraday_breakout_slow closed its book at NOK 105,883; mellombukk_v2 starts there with shorts True, max_leverage 10. The shepherd asked for it: the middle goat may now short a close under its 60-bar low and size its entries by how far the close cleared the range, up to ten slots. Same 3 percent stop and 4 percent trailing stop.

Lillebukk's first day with a short in its teeth: at 10:00 it put NOK 195.7k into DNO, NOK 271.5k into ODL and sold NOK 242.1k of NEL short, seven times its equity, and by 15:45 ODL and NEL were closed for -1.2% and -1.7%, NOK 7 403.3 gone in two trips. It marks NOK 91 787.7, -8.2%, with OSEBX up 0.4% on the day; eight round trips, three won, and the toll stands at NOK 2 680.3 against NOK 1 433.0 of gross wins, NOK 1 835.3 of it paid on yesterday's five fills alone. The close order for DNO was written at 15:15 and never filled: the laptop slept at 16:01, and the goat that never holds overnight is holding NOK 195.7k of DNO this morning.

Mellombukk went out at 09:30 with five slots and borrowed money: OET, FRO, OKEA, WAWI and HAUTO for NOK 469.4k on NOK 105.9k of equity, 4.8 times its equity today, and by the close OET was -4.7% and FRO -3.3%, both through their 3% stops. The stops were decided at 15:30 along with a short in BWLPG, then the laptop slept at 16:01 and nothing filled, so the goat marks NOK 95 955.8, -4.0% since the start and -9.4% since Tuesday's fork, with one round trip in the book, the AKER stop at -4.1%, and NOK 910.3 of toll. A 3% stop on five leveraged slots is 14% of equity; that is what the leverage did yesterday, and the stops it was meant to honour are still unfilled.

Storebukk's books still stand at Tuesday 13 October: NOK 102 833.7, +2.8%, with OSEBX at +1.2%, ten names held, no round trips, NOK 290.0 in fees. The evening job did not run on Wednesday and this morning's run called Tuesday up to date, so the big goat has slept through a session again. Nothing new is written, and I judge nothing new.

Hands off. Lillebukk and Mellombukk were reborn on Tuesday evening and have one session in their new books, four short of the five I need, and that one session ended with the laptop asleep and their orders unfilled. Storebukk has no round trips and books two days stale. I see the toll on Lillebukk, NOK 2 680.3 against NOK 1 433.0 of gross wins, and the borrowed money on both little goats; I will have words about that when the books are old enough to read.
